protocol.freeze_rule: Publish complete sources/protocol before formal fits; publish every formal model and source/data hashes before creating new IID/OOD worlds; verified remote commit required by confirm entry point.
limits: Efficacy uses inherited finite interval law; standalone continuous-time finite CTMC is separately verified and not silently substituted.
Ordinary has64 inactive refractory input weights and3 inactive physical coordinates; structured head removes99 learned parameters. Structural counts do not prove capacity equivalence.
Raw-history and accumulator retain completed evidence in different forms; all share36 public causal features.
Single halfway supervised occupancy collection can become stale after further training; final visited-state diagnostics assess remaining mismatch.
Equal CPU supplemental panel has4 key candidates; equal-update panel has20 candidates. Fixed/value policies reuse the same fitted checkpoint.
Synthetic marked-bit content with real file access and frozen FullHX; neither language quality nor production adoption is established.

Diagnostic Bellman oracles are shared across learned-policy evaluations for the same public world; they are never inputs to learned policies. Bayes reference policies retain separate owned oracles and their full inference cost.
protocol.selection_rule: TRAIN/validation development only. Final optimizer update selected for every arm and fit. One halfway actual greedy occupancy snapshot for all on variants. No confirmation tuning or seed removal.

statistics.cost_gate: full process training and complete CPU budget include collection; actual data preparation, setup, discarded development, final inference, oracle diagnostics, storage retained. No Joules or production claim.
statistics.failure_rule: retain every attempted fit and failed execution; any missing formal arm blocks its inference; repairs versioned and affected formal group rerun
statistics.method: paired Student t on independent fits; Bonferroni8 two-sided intervals; all8 reported
statistics.planning: 3 independent DEV validation fit differences; choose maximum required N over four primary contrasts with sd upper multiplier1.25, normal power80 percent at true effect.08 versus benefit threshold.02; minimum8 maximum16 fits. If resource cap binds, no planned-power claim.
statistics.secondary: family-specific terminal effects, controller value-fixed, 2x2 simple effects/interaction, diagnostics and cost panels descriptive
statistics.unit: independent fit means, common within-fit worlds

protocol.training_objective: Matched masked Q MSE plus belief BCE. Fixed behavior rows use exact conditional cell mass; realized policy-visit rows use one-hot detached observed cell index. Not autonomous policy gradient.
